🚀 We’re Hiring: Lead Data Analyst

📍 Location: Remote
💼 Experience: 7+ Years
⏳ Contract Duration: 3-6 Months
📅 Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Preferred

We are looking for an experienced Lead Data Analyst with strong expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, and Cloud Technologies.

🔹 Key Responsibilities:

- Develop and implement advanced statistical and machine learning models (Regression, Classification, Recommendation Systems, NLP, and Computer Vision).
- Work on deep learning architectures such as RNNs, CNNs, and Transformers.
- Perform large-scale data analysis using Python, SQL, Plotly, and Highcharts.
- Develop and optimize complex SQL queries for large datasets.
- Build and deploy ML model APIs on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
- Work with relational and NoSQL databases.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end data science solutions.
- Drive business insights and support strategic data initiatives.

🔹 Required Technical Skills:

- Strong proficiency in Python and advanced SQL.
- Hands-on experience with Machine Learning and Deep Learning.
- Experience with Snowflake or equivalent SQL data warehouses.
- Knowledge of Spark and Big Data technologies.
- Experience with AWS / GCP / Azure.
- API development, CI/CD pipelines, and model deployment experience.
- Snowflake-related data engineering experience is an added advantage.

🎯 Education: Bachelor's / Master's / PhD in Data Science, AI, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.

📩 Interested candidates, please share your updated resume at:
devi.suresh@midyaconsulting.com

Please mention "Lead Data Analyst – Remote" in the subject line.

🔁 Feel free to share this opportunity with your network and help us reach the right talent!

📍 Location: Remote – India
💼 Experience: 8+ Years
🌎 Working Hours: US Shift

🔥 Priority Hiring
ArkaVanta Systems is looking for a senior, client-facing AI Engineer with deep hands-on experience in LLM post-training, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL).
This is not a conventional GenAI or RAG development role. We need someone who can own complex AI solutions end-to-end and work directly with CTOs, VPs of Engineering and AI/ML research leaders.

✅ LLM Post-Training: Hands-on SFT and Reinforcement Learning — both mandatory
✅ RL Techniques: RLHF/RLAIF, PPO, DPO, reward modeling
✅ Fine-Tuning: LoRA, PEFT and related optimisation techniques
✅ Python: NumPy, Pandas and AI/ML engineering
✅ AI Data Engineering: Data generation, labelling, synthetic datasets and evaluation pipelines
✅ Solution Engineering: Agentic AI, RAG, APIs and multi-stage AI workflows

• Design AI data-generation, annotation and evaluation pipelines
• Build and optimise LLM training and post-training workflows
• Develop agentic AI solutions, RAG systems and technical prototypes
• Lead technical discovery and solution discussions with US clients
• Own architecture, delivery quality, timelines and technical outcomes
• Mentor engineers and drive client-facing technical engagements
⭐ Ideal Candidate
✔ 8+ years delivering complex AI/ML or data engineering projects
✔ Demonstrable hands-on experience with both SFT and Reinforcement Learning
✔ Strong client-facing architecture and problem-solving capabilities
✔ Excellent professional English and executive communication
✔ Comfortable working remotely during US hours
⚠️ Candidates with only prompt engineering, chatbot or RAG experience—without hands-on SFT and RL—will not meet the mandatory requirements.
